assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional constraints derived from the announcement's textual extents and approximate areas; no official polygon has been published publicly as of the submission date.
assumptions.impact: All area-based metrics, figures, and the visual page are provisional intake artifacts. They must be recalculated once official or cleared CAD/GIS/PDF boundaries are published; the package must not be used as an official redline or approval basis.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Publish official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA polygons with source, version, CRS, and conversion method; then regenerate all geometry, metrics, figures, PDFs, and HTML.

assumptions.statement: Approved FAR, building height, density, green ratio, setback, road redlines, municipal utilities, and heritage controls are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Statutory indicators (floor_area_ratio, building_height_m) remain unknown with a stated reason; conceptual massing and design ratios are design-model outputs only, not statutory controls. Professional teams must confirm official conditions before statutory use.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Obtain approved regulatory planning conditions or official design-brief attachments.

assumptions.statement: The 'Rail-to-Optics' dual-axis concept, naming system, scenario cards, personas, pilgrimage landmarks, and event operations are conceptual proposals for professional teams to deepen; they are not statutory planning, approved government action, confirmed investment, or engineering feasibility conclusions.
assumptions.impact: All spatial suggestions remain conceptual reference schemes. Brand, signage, fonts, images, and enterprise marks require rights clearing before further use.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: No recalculation trigger; content is reviewed by maintainers and professional reviewers.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints are conceptual massing for design discussion only; existing-building, parcel ownership, and regulatory-plan basemaps are not available in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Building-footprint area and density are low-confidence design-model outputs. Retain/renovate/demolish conclusions are expressed as methods and to-be-calibrated lists.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Provide existing-building survey, cadastral parcels, and approved regulatory plan basemap.
